findings.title: 无模型信号的决策跳过硬失败/缺证据门，并能经独立验收实际采用
findings.trigger: POST /decisions with signals=[], qualification_id=null, status=DECIDED and either a deterministic FAIL result or nonempty missing_evidence.
findings.actual: Both requests return 201 DECIDED. POST /change-proposals returns 201. The standard independent verifier acceptance and apply flow returns APPLIED; ProjectState.current_decision_refs actually changes to the failing receipt.
findings.cause: prepareDecision returns before its hard-results/missing-evidence checks when no signals/qualification exist. validateDecisions only checks status==DECIDED and reference freshness, so historical failing DECIDED receipts can also be proposed.
findings.expected: Hard failures and missing evidence force ABSTAIN or request rejection independently of model signal presence. The adoption boundary also refuses equivalent historical receipts.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove or narrow the no-signal early return so universal hard gates always run; add corresponding adoption-time checks for historical DECIDED receipts without rewriting immutable history.
findings.boundary: The two current request variants are real HTTP + SQLite + independent acceptance/apply flows. The historical variant is an explicit trusted fixture insertion of a canonical immutable pre-fix receipt, followed by real HTTP adoption attempt. No external service or formal holdout used.

verified_in_scope: Independent choice/score/noul response positive and ten malformed/contradictory/unknown-field/schema mutations.
Loopback invocation receives complete subject/input/rubric/evidence Artifact bodies with hash bindings; fixture sends no Authorization credential and cannot assert LIVE.
In-flight subject/evidence/nested dependency invalidation and grant/credential/role revocation refuse publication; Artifact/decision/upload counts remain unchanged.
SQLite sealed metadata/content triggers prevent reclassification, byte-size mutation and body overwrite; unchanged positive invocation remains valid.

HTTP 503, redirect, malformed JSON, negative usage, mismatched confidence, timeout and oversized responses preserve hashed raw evidence and ABSTAIN without adoption or automatic authority; subsequent work continues.
Imported LIVE claims including duplicate signals are downgraded to FIXTURE/jev_called=false and ABSTAIN; JSON cannot mint the private host capability.
Measured high-confidence decisions with FAIL, NOT_RUN or missing evidence ABSTAIN and cannot enter a change proposal.
Canonical raw Artifact reuse preserves one Artifact ID; changed provenance with same content is refused.
Client LIVE declaration and huge claimed dataset counts still produce DRAFT/ADVISORY/jev_called=false; result admission and BOUNDED_AUTO return 503.
limits: No A08 LIVE_SERVICE, independent labels, formal holdout, per-key model qualification or stage signature.
No actual protected-store/AppContainer formal boundary was implemented or verified by this application review.
Host positive testing used an explicit loopback fixture; trusted custom HTTP transports are outside client-supplied HTTP capability.
Historical fixture tests model previously stored canonical receipts; they are not claims that the public API can directly insert arbitrary persisted records.
iteration_notes: independent.stdout.txt was the first probe. Three mutation scenarios tried writes that SQLite immutability triggers correctly rejected; six resulting expectations were probe mistakes, not product findings. The final probe explicitly expects those database guards and retains successful completion.

independent-complete.stdout.txt contains the corrected matrix plus expanded typed/hard-gate coverage; final-independent.stdout.txt adds historical adoption revalidation and is the sole final assertion tally.
